name: dumbbell standing t spine press
description: A standing dumbbell press that adds upper back extension, training shoulder strength and posture together.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and the dumbbells at shoulder height.
Brace your abs and lift your chest tall.
Press the dumbbells overhead while gently extending your upper back.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your lower back.
Lower to your shoulders with control.
